node.title: Re: Script to compare 2 folders, including sub folders and files with content
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [karthik.raju],

Have a look at the "matches" option in [mod://File::DirCompare]. For example, adding this option to your script works for me: matches => sub { print "File contents $_[0] and $_[1] are identical.\n" }

By the way, as the [mod://File::DirCompare] documentation mentions, your script is essentially doing the same thing as [man://diff]: diff --recursive --brief --report-identical-files (or diff -rqs)

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
